title: Moneycontrol + Screener Stock Data Validator
description: Compare public Indian stock data from Moneycontrol and Screener.in. Get both source values, percentage differences, discrepancy flags, and a normalized record without an API key.

symbols.title: NSE symbols or BSE codes
symbols.description: Examples: RELIANCE, TCS, INFY, HDFCBANK, or 500325. Start with one symbol, then scale up.

source.title: Comparison mode
source.description: Compare both sources for validation, or use one source as a fallback.

comparisonTolerancePercent.title: Allowed difference (%)
comparisonTolerancePercent.description: A shared metric is marked as matching when its symmetric percentage difference is at or below this tolerance.

requireBothSources.title: Only save complete comparisons
requireBothSources.description: When enabled, skip a stock unless both Moneycontrol and Screener.in return usable data. Available only in the recommended comparison mode.

consolidated.title: Use consolidated financials
consolidated.description: Use consolidated Screener.in results when available.

includeFinancials.title: Include quarterly and annual results
includeFinancials.description: Adds the latest four quarters and five annual periods from Screener.in. This is optional supporting context, not the Actor's primary comparison output.

includeShareholding.title: Include shareholding pattern
includeShareholding.description: Adds the latest promoter, FII, DII, and public holdings from Screener.in when available.

maxResults.title: Maximum stocks
maxResults.description: Limits the number of unique symbols processed in one run. Increase after confirming the first result.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of stocks processed at the same time. Keep this modest to avoid rate limits.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. No proxy is the cheapest verified default. Try Apify datacenter proxy only if blocking appears; residential traffic can cost more than the Actor fee.
